context_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / EMERGENCY RESCUE (Forest Firefighting + Civil Protection)
emotional_tone: Operational, rugged, trustworthy, high-clarity, mission-ready, Italian emergency services authority

rules.headings: Outfit Variable, font-bold or font-extrabold with tracking-tight

entry_surfaces./: split hero — Squadra AIB Gattinara operational summary & quick punch in/out left, live monthly stats & quick registration right
entry_surfaces./login: branded emergency split screen — squad crest & mission credentials left, volunteer access PIN/password form right
entry_surfaces./register: branded registration split screen — squad onboarding requirements left, volunteer personal data & role profile form right

image_urls.description: Squadra AIB in azione antincendio boschivo con tuta e manichette operative
Sfondo bosco operativo piemontese / prealpi per visual cards di squadra

layouts_and_grids.mobile_first_strategy: Bottom operational bar on mobile with quick 'Registra Ore' FAB, large touch target inputs (min 48px), 1-column responsive card feed for phone screens, full collapsible sidebar for desktop admins.
layouts_and_grids.bento_dashboard: Desktop: 12-column grid. Column 1-4: Quick summary cards (Total AIB hours, Total Protezione Civile hours, Pending approvals, Volunteer rank). Column 5-12: Interactive hour entry logger + Recent entries feed + monthly breakdown chart.
layouts_and_grids.admin_control_room: Dedicated tabs: (1) Approvazione Ore In Attesa, (2) Approvazione Nuovi Volontari, (3) Riepilogo Ore Volontari per Mese/Anno & Export Excel/CSV, (4) Registro Completo con Filtri (Categoria, Tipo Attività, Volontario, Stato), (5) Gestione Volontari & Ruoli Admin.

micro_interactions: Smooth counter tick on total hours increment
Tactile button press animation on 'Invia Ore' and 'Approva/Rifiuta'
Badge status color pulse on pending review items
Slide-in sheet for fast mobile entry logging
Export Excel button with subtle loading spinner and instant download feedback

accessibility_and_locale.test_attributes: All buttons, inputs, select triggers, approval toggles, and metric cards MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='input-date', data-testid='select-category', data-testid='btn-submit-hours', data-testid='btn-approve-entry-123', data-testid='btn-export-excel', data-testid='admin-tab-reports').

instructions_to_main_agent: App must be completely in Italian language with accurate emergency service terminology (Squadra AIB Gattinara, Protezione Civile, Volontario, Caposquadra / Amministratore, Approvato, In Attesa, Rifiutato).
Mobile-first responsive design is crucial because volunteer firefighters log hours straight from smartphones after returning from fire ops or drills.
Implement real Excel (.xlsx with openpyxl in backend or SheetJS / CSV) export for monthly hour reports grouped by volunteer and macro-category.
Ensure pending self-registered users cannot access the app until approved by an admin, with clear 'In attesa di approvazione dal caposquadra' screen.
Admin dashboard must provide quick 1-click batch and single approve/reject for volunteer hours.
Include seed data with realistic Gattinara AIB volunteers, past wildfires, patrol drills, maintenance hours, and pending requests.
